reasoning: Both have solid shared reactive screen state, a single UIScale, a PreferredInput-driven touch layout and safe placement. A keeps the title's UITextSizeConstraint at 24 real px without scaling it, so the title stays small on 4K. B switches to a fixed TextSize that scales with the UIScale. B also keeps its screen facts in one global module with a more robust refresh, so B wins.

criteria.note: Responsive.luau holds a global PreferredInput source, and each Screen derives Size/Scale/SizeClass from a live AbsoluteSize `changed` listener and passes them through a Vide context. It is reusable, but size state lives per Screen rather than in one module.

criteria.criterion: Large screens scale as a whole
criteria.note: One UIScale on the Root frame, bound to computeScale(shortSide/1020), with Root sized at 1/scale so it exactly fills the ScreenGui.

criteria.criterion: Small screens change layout, not shrink
criteria.note: Scale is clamped to at least 1. Compact screens and touch switch to the Bar layout with 48 px tiles.
isBar = isTouch (from PreferredInput) or Compact or the column doesn't fit.
The bar sits at the top centre with an 8 px margin, inside CoreUISafeInsets.
Keeps TextScaled with UITextSizeConstraint MaxTextSize = 24, not multiplied by scale, so the title stays capped at 24 real px on 4K.
Valid Vide bindings, context used correctly, selection preserved, all checks pass. The ring is rebuilt with padding so it scales.

A global Screen module holds viewport, inset, prefersTouch and isLargeDisplay sources, refreshed on ViewportSize, CurrentCamera, TopbarInset and PreferredInput changes, with a guard against the 1x1 startup viewport.

criteria.criterion: Large screens scale as a whole
criteria.note: gameScreenGui adds one UIScale bound to Screen.uiScale (short side/1080, clamped 1-3).

criteria.criterion: Small screens change layout, not shrink
criteria.note: Minimum scale is 1. isPhone triggers the Row layout with 52 px tiles.
isTouchLayout = PreferredInput == Touch or a phone-sized short side.
The row is anchored top-right at (1,-12,0,12) under the default safe insets. The computed inset fact (usableSize) is never used.
Removes UITextSizeConstraint and uses a fixed TextSize from metrics, so UIScale grows it.
Valid Vide (derive/read, bound props), selection intact, all checks pass. The story files are neutral.

strengths: Clean Screen + Responsive context pattern for future screens
Safe insets plus a single UIScale
Uses PreferredInput together with fit-based layout switching
weaknesses: Title UITextSizeConstraint cap is not scaled, so the title stays small on 4K
Size facts are per Screen rather than in one global module

strengths: Single global reactive screen-facts module with a robust refresh
